name: Yamazaki Hajime
source:
He is a teacher at Kisaragi Academy, and teaches English to Class 2-9. He has a deep affection for his students, and with his sympathetic behavior he has given many of his former students dreams and hopes of going to Yale. [url=/c6505]Yui[/url] is one of his former students. These days he is often away on trips to academic conferences and leaves Yui in charge of Class 2-9 as the Vice homeroom teacher. Seeing his students having fun always makes him smile happily.

[From [url=https://corpseparty.fandom.com/wiki/Hajime_Yamazaki]Corpse Party Wiki[/url]]
